    # 2. Variables
    vars = {}

    lin_expr += 6.68 * vars['Var_2']

    lin_expr += 7.29 * vars['Var_3']

    vars['Var_9'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=18.17, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_9')
    lin_expr += 3.9 * vars['Var_9']

    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MINIMIZE)

    # 3. Constraints

    m.addConstr(2.67 * vars['Var_0'] + 5.99 * vars['Var_1'] + 1.83 * vars['Var_5'] + 7.75 * vars['Var_7'] + 3.91 * vars['Var_9'] >= 54.77, name='C11')

    m.addConstr(5.1 * vars['Var_3'] + 5.12 * vars['Var_4'] + 7.92 * vars['Var_6'] + 0.82 * vars['Var_9'] >= 41.93, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(5.57 * vars['Var_1'] + 8.38 * vars['Var_4'] + 1.04 * vars['Var_6'] + 4.68 * vars['Var_7'] >= 53.83, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(8.88 * vars['Var_0'] + 5.09 * vars['Var_3'] + 7.93 * vars['Var_4'] + 6.28 * vars['Var_5'] + 4.21 * vars['Var_7'] >= 122.29, name='C6')
    m.addConstr(4.07 * vars['Var_0'] + 8.86 * vars['Var_1'] + 9.93 * vars['Var_4'] + 3.6 * vars['Var_5'] + 6.04 * vars['Var_6'] + 1.7 * vars['Var_8'] + 8.08 * vars['Var_9'] >= 135.77, name='C7')
    m.addConstr(1.5 * vars['Var_2'] + 3.58 * vars['Var_5'] + 9.8 * vars['Var_6'] + 1.19 * vars['Var_7'] + 0.9 * vars['Var_8'] >= 43.98, name='C8')
    m.addConstr(9.47 * vars['Var_0'] + 0.74 * vars['Var_2'] + 7.97 * vars['Var_3'] + 9.33 * vars['Var_4'] + 7.12 * vars['Var_6'] + 3.79 * vars['Var_9'] >= 153.09, name='C9')
